name: Arini
long_description:
Arini is building the single platform to run all healthcare operations.

Healthcare has spent the last decade consolidating, but operations are still fragmented, manual, and expensive. A large group runs dozens of disconnected systems for scheduling, billing, insurance, payables, and reporting, with people moving data between them by phone, fax, and spreadsheet.


We partner with some of the largest healthcare enterprises in the country through a Forward Deployed Engineering model. Engineers sit with the customer, find their biggest operational problems, and ship systems that solve them end to end. The best of that work becomes the platform that scales across enterprises.

Our goal is to deliver the operating leverage healthcare consolidation has promised for decades, so providers can focus on patient care. We obsess over improving patient outcomes, and we are building the platform to run all operations for a $620B industry.
one_liner: The single platform to run all healthcare operations
